subject: Post-demo alignment: Telemetry pilot scope, metrics, and access guide
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ramos <elena.ramos@cobaltanalytics.com>, Mike Chen <mike.chen@cobaltanalytics.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo alignment: Telemetry pilot scope, metrics, and access guide

Hi Elena / Mike —

Thanks again for taking the demo this morning. Quick recap from our side and a proposed two-week pilot plan so we can get you meaningful latency and cost numbers to evaluate production readiness.

Key pain points you reiterated:
- High 95th percentile inference latency (users report timeouts on complex queries)
- Cost unpredictability when traffic spikes (hard to forecast monthly spend)
- Need for secure handling of PII in prompts and strict egress controls for EU traffic

POC goals (agreed):
- Reduce 95th pct latency for common flows from ~700ms to <=200ms 
- Demonstrate >35% reduction in per-inference token cost using batching + quantization where acceptable
- Validate integration with your observability stack (traces + per-request metrics) for a 10k MAU mock workload

Scope of the Pilot (what we'll run):
- Duration: 2 weeks active testing + 1 week buffer for access/setup
- Models: open-weights candidate (quantized v1) + fallback medium model for high-quality responses
- Workload: 12 representative prompts (attached prompt set), 3 traffic profiles (dev, staging, burst)
- Success metrics: 95th pct latency, median latency, tokens/second cost delta, top-5 generation quality regressions on our eval set

Immediate asks from your side to start setup:
1) Provide a list of static egress IPs or CIDR blocks we should allow (we will send our allowlist).
2) Share a sample of obfuscated prompt data (S3 link or drive) for prompt tuning/evals.
3) Confirm one technical point-of-contact for daily syncs (we'll schedule 15m standups).

Attachments: Cobalt-POC-MAP-20270530.xlsx (pilot map + owners), network-allowlist-ips.txt (our outbound IPs stub)

Proposed owners:
- Redwood: Priyom (engagement lead), Jordan (runtime/observability), Ben (access & infra)
- Cobalt: Elena (POC sponsor), Mike (infra), procurement@cobaltanalytics.com (PO)

Next steps (target dates):
- By EOD Tue 2027-06-01: Cobalt provides allowlist + sample data
- Wed 2027-06-02: Redwood spins up pilot environment and shares endpoints + temporary credentials
- Mon 2027-06-07: Begin load tests & prompt evals (week 1)

If that all sounds right I'll lock in the schedule and send calendar invites for the syncs.

Thanks —
Priyom Das
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

Subject: Fwd: Post-demo alignment: Telemetry pilot scope, metrics, and access guide

Team — forwarding Elena's confirmation and my initial plan. Action items below; tagging owners inline.

Summary: Cobalt confirmed pilot timeframe and will provide S3 sample data and procurement contact. They asked for SOC2 + data handling summary.

Immediate tasks:
- Ben: prioritize the pilot infra spin-up once we have their allowlist. Estimate: 4 hours to provision a dedicated test pool + credentials. Please prepare ephemeral creds and a minimal runbook for the customer. (owner: Ben)
- Jordan: prepare observability hooks & tracing integration doc; we'll send a small artifact to their SREs with trace examples and where to find logs. Also help define the eval metrics instrumentation. (owner: Jordan)
- Monica: draft a short security one-pager (SOC2 summary, retention, and redaction approach) we can send to security@cobaltanalytics.com. Also prepare the DocuSign test contract template. (owner: Monica)

Timeline reminders: provisioning should start as soon as we receive their allowlist (they expect to send by Tue 6/1). I'll schedule a 15-min daily sync at 9:30am PT during the active weeks.

I'll attach the current pilot map and prompt set in the shared drive (link in metadata). Once Ben has endpoints ready I'll send them to Elena & Mike.

Thanks —
Priyom

Subject: Re: Fwd: Post-demo alignment: Telemetry pilot scope, metrics, and access guide

All — quick alignment from runtime/observability side: 

- I'll own trace integration and the eval instrumentation. Plan: add span ids to generation requests and expose 95th/median latency per prompt in the dashboard.
- Ben, happy to pair on the ephemeral creds and test tokens. We should gate the higher-Q fallback model behind a simple feature flag so we can measure quality vs. cost without redeploys.
- Monica, can you confirm the one-pager includes our redaction approach for user-submitted text? Security wants to see how we handle prompt-level PII before we pass probes.

I'll stand up the observability workspace once infra is provisioned; estimate ~6 hours total work.

Jordan
VP, Product Operations | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai
